tickets.subject: Bulldog tee, size S (1 x CC-TEE-WHITE)
tickets.short_outcome: Size S is out of stock (0 on hand), but the reprint is already on open invoice 501, so no duplicate order was placed. Accounting prepared the 3-days-overdue $840.00 invoice 501; the owner approved it, which releases the reprint (about 5 days after payment). Customer Service wrote a privacy-safe reply offering M/L/XL at $28 with no fixed arrival date.

agent_contributions.contribution: Read the ticket, sent Inventory first (stock problem), checked cash, briefed Customer Service on the reply, queued invoice 501 as urgent and marked the ticket resolved.
Confirmed size S = 0 in Aisle B (M 5 / L 3 / XL 2) and that open invoice 501 already covers the reprint (no duplicate order), 5-day lead time; handed the overdue invoice to Accounting.
Checked the cash position and prepared invoice 501 for $840.00 (overdue, urgent, low-cash flag false: $2,560 left still covers the $2,400 rent).
Drafted the reply to T.: size S is being reprinted, about 5 days once released, alternatives M (5), L (3), XL (2) at $28; no internal details.

boss_decisions: Queue the prepared overdue invoice 501 for human approval because it covers the requested size-S reprint; money does not move until the owner approves.
Do not prepare a second purchase because an open invoice already covers CC-TEE-WHITE size S.
Do not promise a fixed arrival date; the 5-day lead time begins after payment approval.

Campus Customs

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount (20 x CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M)
tickets.short_outcome: Boss approved a 15% bulk discount (within its limit): $49.30 each, $986.00 for 20, above the $22.00 unit cost. Only 8 size M are on hand, so Inventory drafted a 12-unit restock ($264.00); it carries a low-cash flag and the Boss deferred it behind rent and invoice 501. The owner left it pending. Customer Service told the club 8 are ready now and the other 12 depend on the restock (about 5 days once released).

agent_contributions.contribution: Sent Accounting (price quote) and Inventory (stock) in parallel, approved the 15% discount within its limit, checked cash and stock, deferred the $264 restock to protect rent, briefed Customer Service on the reply and marked the ticket resolved.
Confirmed 8 M on hand, shortfall 12, no restock already on order; drafted 12 x M from Bulldog Print Co ($264, 5 days) and asked Accounting whether it is affordable.

Quoted 20 at 15% off: $49.30 each, $986.00 total, above cost. On the cash check, the $264 restock would leave less than the $3,240 already owed, so low-cash flag true; re-flagged invoice 501 as the blocking bill (same queue item as ticket 101, not double-paid).
Checked stock and the quote and drafted the reply to Y. A. C.: 8 ready now, 12 need a restock, about 5 days once released, S/L/XL substitutions offered; no costs or cash.

boss_decisions: Approved the 15% discount: the order is 20 units (10+), the discount is within the 15% Boss limit, and $49.30 per unit is above the $22.00 unit cost.
Queued overdue invoice 501 as urgent because it blocks Bulldog shipment; available cash covers the invoice while preserving the $2,400 rent due September 2.
Deferred prepared purchase 1 ($264) because adding it to the invoice and rent would exceed the $3,400 checking balance; its low_cash_flag is true.
No fixed arrival date was promised: restock availability depends on payment approvals, then the reported five-day lead time.

price_override.rationale: Approved at the maximum 15% discount allowed for an order of 10 or more units; price remains above unit cost.
